name: Klaviyo AI
tagline: Klaviyo is the leading email and SMS marketing platform for e-commerce brands, now with extensive AI capabilities including predictive analytics, product recommendations, send-time optimisation, and an AI subject line generator. It integrates natively with Shopify, WooCommerce, and BigCommerce.
